events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today, we reflect on the incredible legacy of Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar pioneer, left us far too soon. What's your favourite riff or track that showcases his genius?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Legacy
events.blurb: Today, we're looking back at The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road', which was originally released on September 26, 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: The legendary 'Abbey Road' album is a masterpiece. Which track instantly transports you to that iconic zebra crossing?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are timeless. What's your ultimate Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Oasis Icon
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! His distinctive vocals defined an era. What's your favourite track he's sung?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album
events.blurb: On this day, we're revisiting John Lennon's powerful album 'Imagine', which first arrived on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album is a timeless piece of music history. Which song from the record resonates with you the most?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Today, we're looking back at the game-changing first Apple iPod, which was unveiled on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Music In Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It changed how we listened to music forever! What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Visionary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. What's his most important song to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: Today, we're diving into The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', which was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' is famously eclectic. Which track do you think is the hidden gem on this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the incomparable Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Queen Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. His stage presence was unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song he delivered so powerfully?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: 'Rubber Soul' marked a pivotal moment for The Beatles. What's your standout track from this influential album?

events.title: John Lennon: A Day of Remembrance
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost music icon John Lennon, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message continue to inspire. What's the song that means the most to you?
